title: TiRex stratified intervention follow-up after critique
status: Prospective protocol for new synthetic data, informed by prior outcomes; retrospective diagnostics remain labeled as such.
execution: CPU, 4 threads, compile and flex attention disabled; public wrapper including uncertainty postprocessing; both TTA disabled

generator.pair_matching: Exactly same value multiset and last observation, one shared affine transformation to mean -9 and SD .6.
generator.freshness: Disjoint contexts and IDs from BOTH splits of BOTH original pilots and from fresh calibration.
generator.limitations: Synthetic histories may differ in many temporal summaries; labels are constructions, not identified exclusive concepts.

selection: All nine identities fixed from the prior run before calibration. No re-ranking or exclusion after new outputs. U666 is the dominant group-run singleton; it is not U103 selected in the earlier single-unit pilot.

primary.unit: Independent synthetic pair within family and motif length;320 percell.
primary.effect: e=(recipient median change - donor median change)/2 in restored log-variance units. Raw sign, no discovery-direction gate.
primary.estimand: Mean numerical influence for each of nine interventions separately in each motif stratum.
primary.test: Two-sided Student t mean test against [-tau,tau]; p=min(1,2*min(t.sf((mean-tau)/SE,n-1),t.sf((-mean-tau)/SE,n-1))); Holm18. Degenerate variance: p1 insideband,p0 outside.
primary.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% paired bootstrap mean intervals from5000 resamples; descriptive, not simultaneous.
primary.meaning: Mean numerical influence under this intervention/generator only; not semantic selectivity, superiority, forecast accuracy or economic importance.
primary.quantile_gate: Record every crossing, do not rearrange. Mark primary numerical interpretation invalid on crossings or nonfinite forecasts.
primary.assumptions: Independent pairs within stratum; Student t inference is approximate for the sampling distribution of the mean at n320, not an exact distribution-free test. Zero-variance p0 outside the numerical band is an explicit deterministic convention.

numerical_calibration.method: tau=max(10*maximum absolute difference from repeated/no-op/batch-invariance calibration forecasts,10*maximum absolute float32 spacing of calibration baseline quantiles). Freeze before validation.
numerical_calibration.null_runs: Repeated baseline, self-value group replacement and reversed/singleton batching on fixed calibration contexts. Include original scalar/group instrumentation.
numerical_calibration.materiality: The factor10 is a predeclared conservative numerical multiplier, not an economic or scientific materiality margin. Deterministic repetition is not stochastic seed uncertainty.
numerical_calibration.mde80: tau+(normal_quantile(1-alpha/(2*18))+normal_quantile(.8))*calibration_SD(e)/sqrt(320). Normal approximation using calibration variance; Bonferroni first-step bound, assumptions stated, report per intervention/stratum.

random_reference.sampling: Uniform without replacement within each eight-unit draw; four-unit prefix. Draws independently sampled so may overlap each other. Exclude original top8 perlayer and U103 inL0.
random_reference.evaluation: Fixed first16 validationpairs per motif/family,32pairs perfamily. Reuse exact contexts across references and candidates.
random_reference.interpretation: Descriptive empirical distribution and rank only. Candidate selected by prior activation outcomes is not exchangeable with random sets; no randomization p-value or causal specificity claim.
random_reference.matching: No hand-matching or tolerance implied. Report input displacement and output magnitude together. No post-result removal.
random_reference.rank_resolution: Nineteen draws provide a coarse reference; any rank fraction has denominator20 and is descriptive, never a p-value.

dose_response.interventions: Eight individual recovery units, original prefix4, suffix4, full8; original donor interpolation a_recipient+alpha*(a_donor-a_recipient) simultaneously, bothdirections.
dose_response.analysis: Joint-minus-sum and deviations from alpha times unit-dose response, recipient/donor separately. Descriptive only; alpha2 is an extrapolation and does not guarantee leaving the local linear regime. Neither additivity nor nonadditivity establishes superposition.
dose_response.reuse: At alpha1 reuse primary subgroup outputs; no new selection.

secondary: Report q10/q50/q90 and q90-q10 changes and both donor/recipient shifts. Exact sign counts/test with numerical neutral band descriptive only, no additional qualification. Report recent-mean correlations only as optional post-result descriptions, never identify a linear readout without direct test.

instrumentation.histories: Fixed first recipient/donor calibration pair in each family/motif cell; twelve contexts.
checks: same-value patch equals baseline at each selected layer
positive affine activation invariance and forecast equivariance
exactly one hook call; temporary hook cleanup; token-to-output index arithmetic
instrumentation.relative_error_formula: max(abs(new-old))/max(1,max(abs(old))) for each activation layer and residual
group_checks: one-member group equals frozen scalar adapter
full base positive affine and no-op gates

failure_policy: Fail closed before validation if instrumentation fails. Preserve failed runs and original output hashes. No criteria changes after new validation. Any new scientific analyses clearly labeled post-result.
verification_language: A separately implemented numerical audit in the same AI-assisted project is internal verification by a second implementation; not independent replication or peer review.

literature.role: Motivation from an informal working-hypothesis essay, not a replicated theorem.
Activation-patching methodological choices can change conclusions; language-model findings motivate explicit controls rather than validating this TiRex experiment.

recent_mean_diagnostic.fit: OLS intercept plus arithmetic mean of the last32 raw history observations, fit only on calibration recency contexts (both motifs and both sides).
recent_mean_diagnostic.evaluation: Frozen fit predicts activation666 on validation recency histories; report levelR2 and paired donor-minus-recipient-differenceR2 separately by motif and pooled.
recent_mean_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive one-feature surrogate only. High R2 within this generator supports approximate linear predictability from this recentmean; it does not identify the unit mechanism or prove a globally linear model. No threshold or inferential claim.
